onscreen: The puzzle: who does the arithmetic? GitHub strips <script>, CSS, inline SVG; MathJax cannot define a macro (measured)

sents.cap: A README is static, so who does the arithmetic?
GitHub strips scripts, CSS, and inline SVG.
Even its MathJax can't define a macro. We measured.

onscreen: Three versions. A (orange): minimal engine on a GitHub Action. B (green): pure MediaWiki. C (green): pure SVG. Legend: orange = Action, green = no Action

sents.cap: Three versions.
A, in orange, runs a minimal engine on a GitHub Action.
B and C, in green, need no Action: pure MediaWiki, pure SVG.

onscreen: Version A, normal: GPT-2 small (124M, int8, perplexity 13.5 vs 13.4 fp32); QA model 600K params, 4-bit, 417 KiB inside the profile README (limit 500 KiB); the engine is one Markdown document run by one line of Python on a GitHub Action; issue 'qa: example text' -> Action -> profile animation; GPT-2 token by token

onscreen: Version C, pure SVG, no code: 7-character context, 224 ReLU units as SVG filters: feConvolveMatrix (multiply-accumulate), feComponentTransfer (ReLU tables), feMorphology (argmax), feDisplacementMap (draw the answer); bit-exact; 47 of 47 training sentences; limits: Chrome, 100% zoom, 1x display, depth-2 limit; live picture, about 5 s

sents.cap: Version C is pure SVG, no code: seven characters of context, 224 ReLU units, drawn as filters.
Convolution does the multiply-accumulates, lookup tables the ReLU, morphology the argmax, and displacement draws the answer.
Your browser computes it, bit-exact, reciting 47 of 47 training sentences.
Limits: Chrome, 100 percent zoom, 1x display, depth two. Chaining deeper crashes.
sents.tts: Limits: Chrome, one hundred percent zoom, one x display, depth two. Chaining deeper crashes.

sents.cap: Here is the live picture. No Action needed.

onscreen: What we tried: numpy engine 0.2 s; XSLT in Chrome 163 s (Chrome removes XSLT 2026-11-17); Liquid in Jekyll 17-22 min (exact); CSS + fonts 11-65 min (extrapolated). Precision: 8-bit activations are the crux: 87.5% without retraining, 100% retrained

sents.cap: What else did we try? XSLT works, but Chrome removes it on November 17th.
Liquid is exact but takes twenty minutes. CSS plus fonts: eleven to sixty-five, extrapolated.
For SVG, precision is the crux: 8-bit gets 87.5 percent without retraining, 100 retrained.
sents.tts: For SVG, precision is the crux: eight-bit gets 87.5 percent without retraining, one hundred percent retrained.
